name: 入库和出库头寸 (7VA)
description_en_html:
Overview

A crucial element of service parts planning is managing the large number of products and locations involved. To reduce inventory and warehouse costs, not every product is stored at every location. Factors such as historical demand and procurement costs influence the decision to stock a product at a specific location.

The Stocking and Destocking functionality lets you define specific business rules within the system. These rules automate the decision-making process regarding whether to stock or destock a product at a location. You can combine multiple parameters to establish these rules, including demand quantity in pieces, the number of order items, procurement costs, and product groups. The decisions based on these rules are documented in the Authorized Stocking List (ASL), which is represented in the Material Master by the replenishment indicator field. Additionally, you can set up an approval process to ensure that any changes to stocking or destocking decisions undergo a manual review.

As an inventory planner, your first task is to create business rules using decision tables that outline the parameters for stocking and destocking decisions. If necessary, you can also define exclusion rules for specific locations to prevent certain products or groups of products from being stored there, particularly if they are hazardous. Next, you assign these business rules to the location and location-product master data. Once the business rules are established, you can execute the stocking and destocking planning services. Afterward, you can review the pending approval results in the Planner Worklist.

Key Process Flow

  • Capture historical demand data
  • Execute stocking and destocking planning
  • Approve stocking and destocking decisions
  • Execute Demand Alignment

Business Benefits

  • Boosts efficiency by automatically determining the material assortment within the distribution network
  • Improves service levels by ensuring the right parts are available at the right time and in the right location.
  • Reduces costs by minimizing stockouts and overstocking

Exclude from Default Activation

Yes

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

Additional License is required for Extended Service Parts Planning.
description_zh_html:
概览

服务备件计划的关键要素是管理大量涉及的产品和地点。为了降低库存和仓库成本，并非每个产品都存储在每个位置。历史需求和采购成本等因素，会影响在特定位置存储产品的决策。

利用入库和出库功能，可以定义系统中的特定业务规则。这些规则自动执行有关在某个位置入库还是出库产品的决策流程。您可以组合多个参数以建立这些规则，包括以件为单位的需求数量、订单项目数、采购成本和产品组。基于这些规则的决策记录在授权库存清单 (ASL) 中，该清单在物料主数据中通过补货标识字段表示。此外，您还可以设置审批流程，以确保对入库或出库决策所做的任何更改都会进行手动检查。

作为库存计划员，您的第一个任务是使用概述入库和出库决策参数的决策表创建业务规则。如有必要，还可以为特定位置定义排除规则，以防止某些产品或产品组存储在此处，尤其是这些产品或产品组有害时。接下来，将这些业务规则分配到位置和位置-产品主数据。建立业务规则后，可以执行入库和出库计划服务。之后，您可以在计划员工作清单中检查待审批结果。

关键流程流

  • 捕获历史需求数据
  • 执行入库和出库计划
  • 批准入库和出库决策
  • 执行需求调整

业务优势

  • 通过在分销网络中自动确定物料分类，提高效率
  • 确保在正确的时间和地点提供正确的部件，提高服务水平。
  • 通过最大限度地减少缺货和库存过剩来降低成本

从默认激活中排除

是

从缺省激活中排除的原因

扩展服务备件计划需要附加许可。
